sections.title: Rate Logic
sections.text_preview:
Each telemetry group can be configured with a rate logic mode that controls when packets are sent:

- **SILENCED** — Packet is never sent.
- **EVERY_MAX** — Packet is sent every MAX delta schedule tic

sections.title: Telemetry Limits
sections.text_preview: As with channel-based telemetry, channels can have limit ranges defined in the dictionary. Limit checking is performed by the ground system.

sections.title: Off Nominal
sections.text_preview:
- If a channel update arrives for a channel not in any packet definition, it is silently ignored.
- If the send cycle cannot complete within the scheduling period, packets may be delayed.
